This structure of composition Mg2Ti8Zn2O20 (reduced formula MgTi4ZnO10) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Zn each in octahedral environments with six oxygen neighbors, while Ti is four-coordinate with oxygen and the O centers have four geometric neighbors. The octahedra share corners with one another, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
